problems: Only one of the three feet shows: the legs are short (they drop to z=-0.18, barely below the hull's -0.10 belly) and are tucked well inside the 0.52 rim, so the card can't show the 'three small round feet underneath'.

Leg layout puts one leg at the front and two at the back, so the back two are hidden behind the hull. Turning the layout so two legs face the camera, with longer legs that splay out, makes the feet read.

The tilt (turn x=10 on top of 14° elevation) tips the top toward the camera and hides the underside even more. A milder tilt still shows the dome and the top while letting the feet show below the rim.
The dome renders as dark teal glass, not the pale green the brief asks for. A lighter, slightly more saturated pale green keeps it reading as pale green after the glass darkens it.
